name: native-history-memory
goal: Keep verification history lookup bounded while preserving trusted ancestry and evidence checks

evidence: Hosted macOS admission timed out at 1742 MiB available; selecting and checking trusted records materializes 46 records twice. A streamed prototype selected the same ancestor and used 1.29 GB RSS instead of 1.70 GB on the same restored history.

test/services/trusted-base.test.ts uses four tiny records; history-fixture-integrity checks lineage only on small histories. Neither checks memory with many large valid records or inherited evidence. Extend the standard trusted-base matrix with a bounded-history workload and intact and damaged ancestry.
